entries.factSourceWordingAliasDecision: The actual Spanish-city article links Mezquita, now a cathedral, to Córdoba. Corduba and Qurtuba are historical names of that city; not the Argentine city or disambiguation page.
entries.initialDecisionDetail: Canonical Córdoba fits C; aliases need not share canonical initial.

entries.initialDecisionDetail: Canonical Dillí fits D; aliases need not share canonical initial.

wholeAdult.audience: general Czech-speaking adult, not a specialist geographer
wholeAdult.reason: Informed monument, confluence and administrative associations dominate. Familiar Copenhagen/Olomouc/Salzburg anchors and harder Essen/Deržprom/Regen/Buryatia edges do not change the overall informed experience. Place-identification monotony is a nonblocking editorial limitation, not a reason to manufacture difficulty. No percentage quota used.

findings.issue: Missing legitimate historical same-city answer Panormos.
findings.excerpt: později zde Řekové vybudovali přístav s názvem Panormos
findings.reason: The clue has no modern-name-only restriction. Palermo/Palermu/Panormos identify the same city; the pack already intentionally accepts analogous Corduba, Qurtuba, Caesaraugusta and Verchněudinsk. A correct historical city answer must not be rejected to keep a two-form finite set.
findings.requiredChange: Add Panormos without removing Palermo or Palermu. Rebind the changed entire question/source alias array and affected current pair/adult judgments. No full factual redo or reauthoring of the other27.
findings.verification: The actual production answer matcher must accept Panormos, Palermo and Palermu; the unchanged initial P and Medium whole rating remain. Publisher/check runner verifies the corrected pack and data release gate separately.
